dateutil/testSecondlyIntervalLarge.reason: RFC 5545 section 3.3.10: INTERVAL is any positive integer. INTERVAL=90061 is 1 day, 1 hour, 1 minute and 1 second; calcard spaces the instances 24525 seconds apart, which is 90061 modulo 65536. dateutil agrees with the RFC

dateutil/testUntilEmpty.reason: RFC 5545 section 3.8.5.3: DTSTART defines the first instance. An UNTIL before it leaves the rule with no instances of its own; calcard refuses the whole event instead

this_and_future_new_length.reason: RFC 5545 section 3.8.4.4: with RANGE=THISANDFUTURE, 'if the duration of the given recurrence instance is modified, then all subsequence instances are also modified to have this same duration'. calcard keeps the master's hour for the later instances

tokyo_until_utc.reason: RFC 5545 section 3.3.10: an UNTIL synchronized with the rule 'becomes the last instance of the recurrence'. 2024-01-04T00:00:00Z is 09:00 in Asia/Tokyo, an instance; calcard drops it
